::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 17th [1864]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 42
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd),
The lamp is decidedly a <u>bright</u> thought.[^1] I will add a bit about [Miss Nightingale](people/person_1086.qmd) to the introduction to bring it in appropriately.

Yours very truly
C. M. Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: It had been decided to use an [illustration](organizations/other_167.qmd) of Florence Nightingale's lamp in *A Book of Golden Deeds*.
